cards.name: Join Shields
cards.oracleText: Untap all creatures you control. They gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. (They can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control. Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy them.)

cards.name: Join Forces
cards.oracleText: Untap up to two target creatures. They each get +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Unite the Coalition
